header.projectName: TEG Dehydration Package - Spreader Bar & Lifting Gear
header.notes: Budgetary technical quotation based on AFC Drawing P-AK024-01Z-SE-790-0005 Rev.02. One lifting-gear set is common for all three trains. Prices are estimated for sourcing evaluation and shall be confirmed after supplier technical review. Customer-facing currency changed to USD. CNY supplier costs are converted at 1 CNY = 0.1483386127 USD, derived from ECB reference rates dated 14 August 2026.
header.terms: Final certified spreader-bar SWL, proof-load factor, governing test standard, witnessing authority, approved vendor/test-facility requirements, complete coating system, NDT scope, and referenced project structural/welding specifications remain subject to purchaser clarification. Supplier shall identify all deviations and exclusions before fabrication.

majorItems.name: Spreader Bar Assembly
majorItems.description: Fabricate and supply one spreader bar strictly to AFC Drawing P-AK024-01Z-SE-790-0005 Rev.02. Approx. 10.24 m long and 6,438.76 kg fabricated weight; main member 32-inch SCH 40 Q355D pipe; 100 mm Q355D(Z) main padeye plates; 10/12/16 mm Q355D plates; four diameter-150 mm padeye holes for Crosby G-2160 300 MT shackles. Includes material traceability, qualified welding, dimensional control, blasting/painting allowance, inaccessible-area sealing, SWL marking, and shop inspection. Final coating system and SWL are to be confirmed.
majorItems.notes: Budgetary fabrication cost. Approved load testing and certification are priced separately below.
